_comment: Dialogue template (schema version 2). Every line is one paragraph with one sentence; speakers are declared once and referenced by id. Validate with: npm run corpus:validate -- path/to/your-file.json. See docs/IMPORT.md.
title: Una conversacion

source.title: My dialogue (course-authored)
source.author: Your name
source.attribution: Written by Your name for the Go course.
source.provenance: Written by Your name, a native speaker, for this course. First draft only: not yet reviewed by a second speaker.

review._comment: Record the review with npm run corpus:review -- <file> --by "<name>" (it also writes contentSignature, the wording the review covers; edit a sentence and you must review again).

speakers._comment: speaker id -> display name. The display name is stored as the sentence's speaker label; it is never part of the sentence text.

english.source: Written by the author of the text
